radio

Single-select item.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
value String No ID of a radio. When a radio is selected, the change event of the radio-group carries value of the radio.
checked Boolean false No Selected or not.
disabled Boolean false No Disabled or not.
color String #09BB07 No Color of radio, which is the same as the CSS color.

Sample Code

1. Single Radio Button

<view class="radio-row">
  <radio value="single" checked="true" color="#2563eb" />
  <text style="margin-left: 8px; font-size: 14px;">Standalone Checked Radio</text>
</view>
Page({ data: {} });
